notes: All 75 Scholar rows were inspected; 74 distinct records match the bibliography and Papers page.
Dartmouth Digital Common s is the repository copy of A framework to identify structured behavioral patterns within rodent spatial trajectories, not a distinct publication.
Scholar records for Modeling motor control and Interactive inference use online-first years (2023); the final IEEE issue year is 2024.
Sensorimotor communication for humans and robots uses the final IEEE issue year 2018; the existing BibTeX key retains 2017 for citation compatibility.
PAM is dated 2024 according to the arXiv submission; no final journal publication was verified.
The PhD thesis bibliography uses the repository year 2009; the confirmed defence date 17 February 2010 is preserved in the CV and website.
Conference abstracts, posters, invited talks, editorials and the author correction are identified explicitly; arXiv manuscripts use the requested under review convention.
The three non-Scholar contributions retained in both CV and website are MONA 2024, the invited ICRA 2020 talk and ECVP 2019.
